idea-plugin.name: KMPSkills Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
💎 KMPSkills Assistant for Android Studio & IntelliJ IDEA

Enterprise AI Skills, MVI Feature Scaffolder, Room KMP Generator, and Architectural Diagnostics for Android Native & Kotlin Multiplatform.

Key Capabilities:

  • Sidebar Tool Window: Interactive browser for all 27 architectural skills and 10-level masterclass curriculum.
  • 1-Click AI Rule Injection: Automatically configures .github/copilot-instructions.md for GitHub Copilot & Gemini Code Assist.
  • MVI Feature Generator: Right-click any folder to scaffold complete, warning-free MVI UiState, UiIntent, UiEffect, ViewModel, and Compose Screen.
  • Room KMP Scaffolder: Generates type-safe Room Entity and reactive DAO with BundledSQLiteDriver.
  • Architecture Doctor: Audits your project's libs.versions.toml and Kotlin/Compose compatibility in real-time.
